articles.title: Sync Agent Fails to Connect
articles.resolution: Verify outbound TCP 8443 is allowed. Check certificate expiry with 'cloudsync cert status'. Run 'cloudsync diag network' for connectivity test. If all checks pass, contact support with diagnostic bundle.

articles.title: High CPU Usage During Sync
symptoms: CPU usage exceeds 80% during sync windows
articles.resolution: Add CloudSync directories to antivirus exclusion list. Reduce concurrent sync threads in settings (default 8, try 4). Ensure system meets recommended RAM requirements. Consider upgrading to SSD storage.

articles.title: Files Not Syncing to Specific Team Members
symptoms: Files visible to some team members but not others
articles.resolution: Check namespace policies in admin console under Team > Policies. Verify all clients are on version 3.1+. Run 'cloudsync index rebuild' on affected client. If selective sync rules are active, verify member is in correct group.

articles.title: Sync Conflict Errors
symptoms: File shows conflict marker in UI
articles.resolution: CloudSync automatically creates conflict copies. Review both versions and merge manually. Enable automatic conflict resolution in settings for non-binary files. Ensure NTP time sync is enabled on all client devices.

articles.title: Slow Initial Sync for Large Repositories
causes: Throttling on initial sync by design
WAN latency between client and nearest region
articles.resolution: Use CloudSync Bulk Import tool for repositories over 100 GB. Contact support to temporarily lift initial sync throttle. Consider deploying a local sync relay in your region. Available regions: us-west, us-east, eu-central, ap-southeast.
